layout.hierarchy: Title dominates visually (largest, red and blue); neural network diagram is the largest graphical element; equation box is secondary; classification label box is smallest; body text is smaller than title.

visual_elements.description: Single-layer perceptron neural network diagram. Left side shows input nodes labeled x_1, x_2, x_3, ..., x_n, and a bias input '1'. Colored weight lines fan out to the right: red weights (w_{11}, w_{12}, w_{13}, ..., w_{1n}, b_1) connect to the first summation node; blue weights (w_{21}, w_{22}, w_{23}, ..., w_{2n}, b_2) connect to the second summation node; green weights (w_{m1}, w_{m2}, ..., w_{mn}, b_m) connect to the last summation node. Vertical ellipsis (...) appears between the second and last neuron. Each summation node is a light blue circle containing 'Σ'. Each Σ connects via a red arrow to a purple rectangular activation box. Outputs to the right show threshold decisions: '>0 Class I' / '<0 Not Class I', '>0 Class II' / '<0 Not Class II', vertical ellipsis, and '>0 Class m' / '<0 Not Class m'.
Rounded rectangle with light peach/orange background containing the three equations for d_1(X), d_2(X), and d_m(X) in black text.
Tan/beige rectangle containing the text 'Multi-Class Classification' in dark brown/black text.
Circle outline containing the slide number '6' in black text.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large and bold, with 'Visualization of' and 'Perceptron' in red and 'Single Layer' in blue. Body text is regular weight black. Equations use subscript notation. The 'Multi-Class Classification' label is in a smaller serif or sans-serif font inside the tan box.
animation_state: Nothing appears mid-build; all elements are fully visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#f2f2f2).
2. Add title at top-left/center: 'Visualization of Single Layer Perceptron' in large bold sans-serif; color 'Visualization of' and 'Perceptron' red (#c00000), color 'Single Layer' blue (#0000ff).
3. Add a circle in the top-right corner containing the number '6'.
4. On the left side, upper portion, add a rounded rectangle with peach background (#fdebd0). Inside it, type three lines exactly as: d_1(X) = W_1^T X = w_{11}x_1 + w_{12}x_2 + ... + w_{1n}x_n + b_1 * 1 ; d_2(X) = W_2^T X = w_{21}x_1 + w_{22}x_2 + ... + w_{2n}x_n + b_2 * 1 ; d_m(X) = W_m^T X = w_{m1}x_1 + w_{m2}x_2 + ... + w_{mn}x_n + b_m * 1 .
5. Below the equation box on the left, add a tan rectangle (#e6d5b8) with text 'Multi-Class Classification'.
6. On the right side, draw a large white-area diagram: input labels x_1, x_2, x_3, ..., x_n, 1 on the far left. Draw weighted connection lines in red (first neuron), blue (second neuron), and green (last neuron) with labels w_{11}, w_{12}, w_{13}, ..., w_{1n}, b_1 ; w_{21}, w_{22}, w_{23}, ..., w_{2n}, b_2 ; w_{m1}, w_{m2}, ..., w_{mn}, b_m . Include vertical ellipsis between the second and last neuron.
7. Draw three light blue circles containing 'Σ' (summation nodes) aligned vertically on the right side of the weight fan-in. Add vertical ellipsis between the second and third Σ.
8. From each Σ draw a red arrow to a purple rectangular activation box. To the right of each box add output text: first row '>0 Class I' and '<0 Not Class I'; second row '>0 Class II' and '<0 Not Class II'; last row '>0 Class m' and '<0 Not Class m', with vertical ellipsis between second and last output rows.
9. Ensure all text is black unless specified otherwise, and use sans-serif fonts for diagram labels.
